<div class="markdown-heading"><h2 class="heading-element">Introduction</h2><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p>Proof of Origin (PO) Token is a parameter that YouTube requires to be sent with requests from some clients. Without it, requests for the affected clients' format URLs may return HTTP Error 403, or result in your account or IP address being blocked.</p>
<p>A PO Token is generated by an attestation provider on Web, Android and iOS platforms to attest the requests are coming from a genuine client.</p>
<p>For yt-dlp, you can provide PO Token(s) using the <a href="https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#youtube"><code>po_token</code> extractor argument</a>, or you can <a href="#po-token-provider-plugins">install a plugin</a> that hooks into the YouTube extractor to handle fetching a PO Token.</p>
<p>For more technical details on these tokens, refer to the <a href="#technical-details">technical details section</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading"><h2 class="heading-element">Cases where a PO Token is required</h2><a id="user-content-cases-where-a-po-token-is-required" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Cases where a PO Token is required" href="#cases-where-a-po-token-is-required"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p>There are currently three cases yt-dlp may require PO Tokens for video downloads, <a href="#current-po-token-enforcement">depending on the client used</a>:</p>
<ul>
<li>GVS: Google Video Server requests (video streaming - https, dash, hls, etc.)</li>
<li>Player: Innertube <code>player</code> requests (fetch video format URLs)</li>
<li>Subs: Subtitle requests</li>
</ul>
<p>The PO Tokens may be generated differently for each of these cases, depending on the client.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading"><h3 class="heading-element">Current PO Token enforcement</h3><a id="user-content-current-po-token-enforcement" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Current PO Token enforcement" href="#current-po-token-enforcement"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p>YouTube is at present rolling out changes to enforce PO Tokens for video playback. Currently, only GVS and Subs require PO Tokens for some clients.</p>
<table role="table">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Client</th>
<th>PO Token Required For</th>
<th>Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>web</code></td>
<td>Subs, GVS</td>
<td>Only SABR formats available</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>web_safari</code></td>
<td>GVS*</td>
<td>Same as <code>web</code>. *Provides HLS (m3u8) formats which do not require PO Token for GVS at this time.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>mweb</code></td>

<div class="markdown-heading"><h2 class="heading-element">Technical details</h2><a id="user-content-technical-details" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Technical details" href="#technical-details"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p>PO Tokens are still an active area of research, and at the same time YouTube is continuously updating the implementation and enforcement. The following information is based on the current understanding of PO Tokens, and is subject to change.</p>
<p>A PO Token is generated by either BotGuard (Web), DroidGuard (Android), iOSGuard (iOS). A PO Token from one platform cannot be used on another (i.e., Web PO Token cannot be used on Android or iOS).</p>
<p>PO Tokens have a "content binding", meaning they are bound to the user session (Visitor ID or account Session ID) or to the video ID. Most PO Tokens (such as for <code>web</code> GVS/Player) are bound to the video ID, so a new token is required for each video.</p>
<p>These PO Tokens have a limited lifespan (possibly as short as 12 hours), so they will need to be refreshed periodically. However, some reports suggest that the token may be valid for several months.</p>
<p>If you are interested, we recommend checking out the <a href="https://github.com/LuanRT/BgUtils">BgUtils</a> project which does a deeper dive into the BotGuard attestation process.</p>
